objective: test whether controller-bound full-match utility improves three-round match score, whether raw policy evaluation or isotonic optimal-value regularization is safer, and whether the table should act from ply 0 or ply 14

must_freeze: current remote commit after all accepted patches
compiler identity, version, target architecture, optimization flags, floating-point flags, and expected match-value build-profile word
source commit and hashes of match-value/controller source files
deterministic table-build command, seed, samples, role schedule, and output paths
prebuild_manifest_required_before_table_.rule: do not build either table until this manifest exists; table generation itself is not an efficacy test

must_freeze: raw and isotonic table paths, SHA-256 values, payload fingerprints, and maximum projection adjustments
winning rollout world cap and complete actor strings
compiler identity, optimization flags, source commit, source hashes, and observed match-value build-profile word
all match commands, development seeds, reciprocal orientations, pair counts, shard matrix, and mechanical selection rules
pre_efficacy_execution_addendum_required.rule: do not run a single efficacy match until this post-build addendum exists and verifies both deterministic artifacts against the prebuild manifest

inactive_dimension_note.reason: the frozen actor has semantic_cand=0, no draw or planner extras, policy_prefix_mode=3, and all generated candidates marked trusted; the low-prior qualifier therefore never consults override_min
inactive_dimension_note.verified_effect: actors differing only in override_min serialize byte-for-byte identically for this controller
inactive_dimension_note.decision: hold override_min at 2.0 and do not spend matches pretending to tune an unreachable parameter

baseline.name: legacy
baseline.description: authoritative winner of the locked world800 campaign, including its winning world cap

stage_1_factorial_screen.purpose: estimate the raw/projected by ply14/all-ply interaction without adaptive threshold screening
stage_1_factorial_screen.selection_rule: maximize equal-weight mean match score over the two reciprocal blocks; then maximize equal-weight mean margin; if still exactly tied use the fixed order P14, R14, P0, R0
stage_1_factorial_screen.failure_rule: reject the whole screen if any shard is missing, any raw pair row is missing or duplicated, any cap occurs, or either artifact fails validation

stage_2_development_confirmation.participant: mechanical winner of stage 1 versus legacy
stage_2_development_confirmation.pass_rule: combined equal-weight reciprocal match score is above 50%, each reciprocal block is above 50%, combined equal-weight margin is positive, capped rounds are zero, and every raw-pair and artifact validation check passes
stage_2_development_confirmation.interpretation: development evidence only; passing permits definition of a new disjoint locked final test but does not promote the actor

locked_final_test_reservation.promotion_gate: combined pair-clustered 90% lower confidence bound is above 50%, point estimate is above 50%, each reciprocal block is above 50%, combined equal-weight margin is positive, capped rounds are zero, and all exact integrity checks pass

attribution_caveat: objective 3 changes both early-round Bellman continuation utility and final-round utility from pure margin to the declared hybrid match utility; a strength result establishes the complete actor's effect, not isolated causality for the Bellman table. Objective 2 is a future attribution control, not part of this preregistered strength panel.
forbidden: inspecting or acting on partial efficacy results
using any existing locked efficacy seed
changing an actor, table, phase, world cap, seed, shard count, or selection rule after the pre-efficacy addendum
screening arbitrary practical-effect thresholds for an inactive parameter
executing the locked final reservation before its separate addendum is committed
